decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed roof extension, by way of position, size, scale and appearance, has due regard for the site characteristics and the surrounding built environment and would not harm neighbours living conditions or the appearance of the area and if carried out concurrently with the approved extension at 177 Heath Road would comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003, Adopted December 2003; and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no roof extensions/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.
Condition : 6 - The window formed in the eastern side dormer shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse.
